projectDesc.p: Text digitized and encoded for use in the Forager Folklore Database.

body.p: One day the kapitsil, (a big and very poisonous serpent) decided to fight against the rattle-snake. He said he would surely win because he was much the stronger. The rattlesnake realized it would be difficult for him to win because of the size of the kapitsil, but he accepted the challenge. They had a terrible fight and at last they killed each other. Their bodies lay on the ground where they had fallen, swollen and rotten.
